en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning issued this morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory activated the warning at 6.45am as mainly fine and very hot conditions are expected, with urban temperatures reaching about 33 degrees.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Very Hot Weather Warning at 6.45am on Thursday. It remains in force as mainly fine and very hot weather continues across the territory.

Temperatures are expected to climb to about 33 degrees in urban areas during the day, with readings two to three degrees higher in the New Territories. Light winds are forecast. The maximum UV index is expected to reach 12, indicating extreme intensity.

The Observatory advised the public to take precautions against heat stroke. People working outdoors or engaged in outdoor activities should wear light-coloured, loose-fitting clothing and a wide-brimmed hat, stay in the shade when possible, and drink plenty of water while avoiding caffeine and alcohol. Those who feel unwell should rest and seek medical advice promptly.

Outlooks point to mainly fine and persistently very hot conditions over the next few days, with extremely hot weather possible in some areas on Friday and over the weekend, apart from isolated showers.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告今早生效
zh.dek: 天文台上午6時45分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料今日大致天晴酷熱，市區最高氣溫約33度，新界再高兩三度。
body: 香港天文台於周四上午6時45分發出酷熱天氣警告，警告現正生效。本港繼續受大致天晴及酷熱天氣影響。
預料日間市區最高氣溫約33度，新界再高兩三度，吹微風。今日最高紫外線指數大約是12，強度屬極高。
天文台提醒市民慎防中暑。在戶外工作或活動的人士應穿着淺色寬鬆衣物及戴闊邊帽，盡量留在陰涼處，多喝水，避免飲用含咖啡因或酒精的飲品。如感不適，應立即休息並盡快求醫。
展望未來數日大致天晴，天氣持續酷熱。明日及周末期間部分地區或會極端酷熱，但局部地區有驟雨。
